rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only candidate must finish reliably before shorter lap times matter.
observable_information: Current 84x84 grayscale road rows, near asphalt width, far road direction, visible obstacle cues, and actions of exact-hash fixed pixel actors.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Use the activated quarter-half-width inside-bend steering correction only on fully visible unobstructed road where the fast learned pedal is already selected.
expected_success_endpoint: At least the selected control's finish count across 12 new official tune cells, then a lower median finished lap time with no invalid actions.
control: Selected full-road-guard actor and prior fast-pedal-stable-steer actor on the exact same 12 cells; fixed checkpoint hashes and protocol.
falsifier: Lower finish count than selected control, invalid action, or tied completion with no median lap-time improvement on registered tune cells.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Track 1, 2, 3 crossed with seeds 296, 297, 298, 299, three fixed arms, 2000 decisions per cell and full action traces.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux/Python 3.11 CPU, 1800-second registered diagnostic timeout, no tune map geometry used for training, no held-out/confirmation use, no website action.
